# New Patient Tower

- **Goal / definition of done:** add a new inpatient tower at Riverbend General — **96 private
  beds** plus expanded ICU — to relieve the capacity constraint driving ED boarding. Target
  substantial completion **2027-Q3**, occupancy early 2028.
- **Executive owner:** [David Reinhart](../people/david-reinhart.md) (CFO) — it is a major
  capital project; construction is managed by an external general contractor. Sponsor:
  [Marcus Bell](../people/marcus-bell.md) (CEO).
- **Status:** active; **on schedule** and **on budget** as of July 2026; steel topping-out
  complete. The **FY27 capital budget line** still needs Diane's approval (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md)).

## Why it matters operationally
- The single largest structural fix for occupancy and
  [ED throughput](ed-throughput.md) — but relief is **2028**, so near-term throughput must come
  from bed-flow and the Epic bed-management module.
